thought.text: Now let me wait for the three cached builds to complete, monitoring memory carefully:

reasoning_content:
Hmm, wait a moment. There's a problem here: I rendered nginx with ports 39001/39002/39003, but `just serve` reads ports.json — which still lists 39001/39002/39003 (the render preserved them because they were free). Good, it's consistent.

Alright, let's wait for the build (cached, so it should be faster). I'll monitor memory carefully.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 11); do
  up=0
  for p in 39001 39002 39003; do
    code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$code" = "200" ] && up=$((up+1))
  done
  echo "check $i: $up/3  avail=$(free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $6}')MB"
  [ $up -eq 3 ] && break
  sleep 45
done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
